name: analytics-saas
title: SaaS revenue
description: A glass SaaS revenue dashboard for React: MRR, churn, cohort retention and plan movement with animated charts and rolling KPI tiles. Tailwind v4, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
SaaS revenue: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/dashboards/saas

Installed in components/sheenui/blocks/. Import (use your components alias):
import { SaasRevenueDashboard } from "@/components/sheenui/blocks/analytics-saas";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
